40021568.author: पदार्थः
40021568.content: तथा thus, स्म (past tense particle), तेषां of them, वसतां while dwelling, ऋक्षवानररक्षसाम् of the bears, monkeys, and Rakshasas, राघवः Rama, तु indeed, महातेजाः of great splendor, सुग्रीवम् to Sugriva, इदम् this, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40021568.author: Translation
40021568.content: While those bears, monkeys, and Rakshasas were thus dwelling, the greatly effulgent Rama then spoke these words to Sugriva.

40021569.author: पदार्थः
40021569.content: गम्यतां go, सौम्य O gentle one, किष्किन्धां to Kishkindha, दुराधर्षां unassailable, सुरासुरैः by gods and demons, पालयस्व rule, सहामात्यो with your ministers, राज्यं the kingdom, निहतकण्टकम् free from enemies.

40021569.author: Translation
40021569.content: O gentle one, go to Kishkindha, which is unassailable even by gods and demons, and rule your kingdom with your ministers, having removed all its enemies.

40021570.author: पदार्थः
40021570.content: अङ्गदं Angada, च and, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, प्रीत्या with affection, परमया supreme, युतः endowed with, पश्य see, त्वं you, हनुमन्तं Hanuman, च and, नलं Nala, च and, सुमहाबलम् of great strength.

40021570.author: Translation
40021570.content: O mighty-armed one, you should look upon Angada, Hanuman, and Nala of great strength with supreme affection.

40021571.author: पदार्थः
40021571.content: सुषेणं Sushena, श्वशुरं your father-in-law, वीरं the brave, तारं Tara, च and, बलिनां among the strong, वरम् the best, कुमुदं Kumuda, चैव and also, दुर्धर्षं unassailable, नीलं Nila, चैव and also, महाबलम् of great strength.

40021571.author: Translation
40021571.content: Also see the brave Sushena, your father-in-law, Tara, the best among the strong, and the unassailable Kumuda, and Nila of great strength.

40021572.author: पदार्थः
40021572.content: वीरं the brave, शतवलिं Shatavali, चैव and also, मैन्दं Mainda, द्विविदमेव and Dvivida, च and, गजं Gaja, गवाक्षं Gavaksha, गवयं Gavaya, शरभं Sharabha, च and, महाबलम् of great strength, पश्य see, प्रीतिसमायुक्तो filled with affection, गन्धमादनमेव and Gandhamadana, च and.

40021572.author: Translation
40021572.content: Look with affection upon the brave Shatavali, Mainda, Dvivida, Gaja, Gavaksha, Gavaya, Sharabha of great strength, and Gandhamadana.

40021573.author: पदार्थः
40021573.content: ऋषभं Rishabha, च and, सुविक्रान्तं very valorous, जाम्बवन्तं Jambavan, महाबलम् of great strength, ये those who, च and, इमे these, सुमहात्मानो great-souled ones, मदर्थे for my sake, त्यक्तजीविताः who risked their lives.

40021573.author: Translation
40021573.content: Also see Rishabha, the very valorous, and Jambavan of great strength, and all these other great-souled beings who risked their lives for my sake.

40021574.author: पदार्थः
40021574.content: पश्य see, त्वं you, प्रीतिसंयुक्तो endowed with affection, मा not, च and, एषां to them, विप्रियं harm, कृथाः do.

40021574.author: Translation
40021574.content: You should look upon them with affection and never cause them any harm.

40021575.author: पदार्थः
40021575.content: एवमुक्त्वा having said thus, तु then, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, आश्लिष्य having embraced, च and, पुनः पुनः again and again, विभीषणम् to Vibhishana, उवाच spoke, अथ then, रामो Rama, मधुरया with sweet, गिरा words.

40021575.author: Translation
40021575.content: Having spoken thus and repeatedly embraced Sugriva, Rama then addressed Vibhishana with sweet words.

40021576.author: पदार्थः
40021576.content: लङ्कां Lanka, प्रशाधि rule, धर्मेण with righteousness, धर्मज्ञः one who knows dharma, त्वं you, मतो considered, मम by me, पुरस्य of the city, राक्षसानां of the Rakshasas, च and, स्वभ्रातुः by your own brother, सम्मतो approved, हि indeed, असि you are.

40021576.author: Translation
40021576.content: Rule Lanka righteously, for I consider you knowledgeable in dharma, and you are indeed approved by your own brother, by the city, and by the Rakshasas.

40021577.author: पदार्थः
40021577.content: मा not, च and, बुद्धिम् mind, अधर्मे in unrighteousness, त्वं you, कुर्याः should place, राजन् O King, कथञ्चन ever, बुद्धिमन्तो intelligent, हि indeed, राजानो kings, ध्रुवम् certainly, अश्नन्ति enjoy, मेदिनीम् the earth.

40021577.author: Translation
40021577.content: O King, never let your mind incline towards unrighteousness, for intelligent kings certainly rule the earth.

40021578.author: पदार्थः
40021578.content: अहं I, च and, नित्यशो always, राजन् O King, सुग्रीवसहितः along with Sugriva, त्वया by you, स्मर्तव्यः should be remembered, परया with great, प्रीत्या affection, गच्छ go, त्वं you, विगतज्वरः free from sorrow.

40021578.author: Translation
40021578.content: O King, you should always remember me and Sugriva with great affection; now go, free from all sorrow.

40021579.author: पदार्थः
40021579.content: रामस्य of Rama, भाषितं speech, श्रुत्वा having heard, ऋक्षवानरराक्षसाः bears, monkeys, and rakshasas, साधुसाध्विति "Excellent! Excellent!" thus, काकुत्स्थं Kakutstha (Rama), प्रशशंसुः praised, पुनः पुनः again and again.

40021579.author: Translation
40021579.content: Having heard Rama's words, the bears, monkeys, and rakshasas repeatedly praised him, exclaiming "Excellent! Excellent!"

40021580.author: पदार्थः
40021580.content: तव Your, बुद्धिः intellect, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, वीर्यम् valor, अद्भुतम् wonderful, एव indeed, च and, माधुर्यं sweetness, परमं supreme, राम O Rama, स्वयम्भोः of the Self-born (Brahma), इव like, नित्यदा always.

40021580.author: Translation
40021580.content: O mighty-armed Rama, your intellect and valor are truly wonderful, and your supreme sweetness is eternal, like that of the Self-born Brahma.

40021581.author: पदार्थः
40021581.content: तेषाम् of them, एवम् thus, ब्रुवाणानां speaking, वानराणां of the monkeys, च and, राक्षसाम् of the rakshasas, हनूमान् Hanuman, प्रवणः bowing down, भूत्वा having become, राघवं to Raghava (Rama), वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40021581.author: Translation
40021581.content: While the monkeys and rakshasas were speaking thus, Hanuman, bowing down humbly, addressed Rama.

40021582.author: पदार्थः
40021582.content: स्नेहः affection, मे my, परमः supreme, राजन् O King, त्वयि in you, तिष्ठतु may it remain, नित्यदा always, भक्तिः devotion, च and, नियता constant, वीर O hero, भावः feeling, न not, अन्यत्र elsewhere, गच्छतु may it go.

40021582.author: Translation
40021582.content: O King, may my supreme affection for you remain always, and O hero, may my devotion be unwavering, with my feelings never straying elsewhere.

40021583.author: पदार्थः
40021583.content: यावत् as long as, रामकथा the story of Rama, वीर O hero, चरिष्यति will prevail, महीतले on the earth's surface, तावत् so long, शरीरे in the body, वत्स्यन्ति will reside, प्राणाः life breaths, मम my, न not, संशयः doubt.

40021583.author: Translation
40021583.content: O hero, as long as the story of Rama is told on the earth, my life breaths will undoubtedly remain in my body.

40021584.author: पदार्थः
40021584.content: यत् which, च and, एतत् this, चरितं divine story/deed, दिव्यं divine, कथा story, ते your, रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghus, तत् that, मया by me, अप्सरसः Apsaras, नाम indeed, श्रावयेयुः should make me hear, नरर्षभ O best among men.

40021584.author: Translation
40021584.content: O Rama, delight of the Raghus and best among men, may the Apsaras indeed make me hear this divine story and your divine deeds.

40021585.author: पदार्थः
40021585.content: तत् that, श्रुत्वा having heard, अहं I, ततः then, वीर O hero, तव your, चर्यामृतं nectar-like deeds/story, प्रभो O lord, उत्कण्ठां longing/sorrow, तां that, हरिष्यामि I shall remove, मेघलेखाम् a line of clouds, इव like, अनिलः wind.

40021585.author: Translation
40021585.content: O hero, O lord, having heard that nectar-like story of your deeds, I shall then remove that longing/sorrow, just as the wind disperses a line of clouds.

40021586.author: पदार्थः
40021586.content: एवं thus, ब्रुवाणं speaking, रामः Rama, तु indeed, हनूमन्तं Hanuman, वरासनात् from his excellent seat, उत्थाय having risen, सस्वजे embraced, स्नेहात् out of affection, वाक्यम् word, एतत् this, उवाच spoke, ह indeed.

40021586.author: Translation
40021586.content: Rama, having risen from his excellent seat, embraced Hanuman who was speaking thus, and out of affection, indeed spoke these words.

40021587.author: पदार्थः
40021587.content: एवम् thus, एतत् this, कपिश्रेष्ठ O best of monkeys, भविता it will be, न no, अत्र here, संशयः doubt, चरिष्यति will spread/exist, कथा story, यावत् as long as, एषा this, लोके in the world, च and, मामिका my, तावत् so long, ते your, भविता will be, कीर्तिः fame, शरीरे in the body, अपि even, असवाः life-breaths, तथा similarly.

40021587.author: Translation
40021587.content: O best of monkeys, it will indeed be so, there is no doubt about it; as long as this story of mine spreads in the world, so long will your fame and life-breaths remain in your body.

40021588.author: पदार्थः
40021588.content: लोकाः worlds/people, हि indeed, यावत् as long as, स्थास्यन्ति will exist/remain, तावत् so long, स्थास्यति will exist/remain, मे my, कथा story.

40021588.author: Translation
40021588.content: Indeed, as long as the worlds exist, so long will my story endure.

40021589.author: पदार्थः
40021589.content: लोके in the world, च and, मामिका mine (gratitude), एकैकस्य of each and every, उपकारस्य favor, प्राणान् lives, दास्यामि I will give, ते to you, कपे O monkey, नरः a man, प्रत्युपकाराणाम् of return favors, आपस्त्वायाति आपत्सु in distress, आयाति comes, पात्रताम् worthiness.

40021589.author: Translation
40021589.content: Rama declares that his gratitude is such that he would give his life for each of Hanuman's favors, emphasizing that a person becomes worthy of receiving return favors even when in distress.

40021590.author: पदार्थः
40021590.content: ततः then, अस्य his (Rama's), हारम् necklace, चन्द्राभम् moon-like, मुच्य having taken off, कण्ठात् from the neck, सः he, राघवः Rama, वैडूर्यतरलम् with a cat's eye gem pendant, कण्ठे on the neck, बबन्ध tied, च and, हनूमतः of Hanuman.

40021590.author: Translation
40021590.content: Then, Rama took off his own moon-like necklace from his neck and fastened it, adorned with a cat's eye gem, onto Hanuman's neck.

40021591.author: पदार्थः
40021591.content: तेन by that, उरसि on the chest, निबद्धेन fastened, हारेण by the necklace, महता great, कपिः the monkey (Hanuman), रराज shone, हेमशैलेन्द्रः like a great golden mountain, चन्द्रेण by the moon, आक्रान्तमस्तकः whose peak is covered.

40021591.author: Translation
40021591.content: With that great necklace fastened on his chest, Hanuman shone like a magnificent golden mountain whose peak is adorned by the moon.

40021592.author: पदार्थः
40021592.content: श्रुत्वा having heard, तु indeed, राघवस्य of Rama, एतत् this, उत्थायोत्थाय repeatedly rising up, वानराः the monkeys, प्रणम्य having bowed, शिरसा with their heads, पादौ at the feet, निर्जग्मुः they departed, ते those, महाबलाः mighty ones.

40021592.author: Translation
40021592.content: Having heard these words from Rama, those mighty monkeys repeatedly rose, bowed their heads at his feet, and then departed.

40021593.author: पदार्थः
40021593.content: सुग्रीवः Sugriva, सः he, च and, रामेण by Rama, निरन्तरम् closely, उरोगतः embraced, विभीषणः Vibhishana, च and, धर्मात्मा righteous-souled, सर्वे all, ते they, बाष्पविक्लवाः overcome with tears.

40021593.author: Translation
40021593.content: Sugriva, who was constantly embraced by Rama, and the righteous Vibhishana, along with all the others, were overcome with tears.

40021594.author: पदार्थः
40021594.content: सर्वे all, च and, ते they, बाष्पकलाः full of tears, साश्रुनेत्राः with tearful eyes, विचेतसः bewildered, सम्मूढाः stupefied, इव as if, दुःखेन by sorrow, त्यजन्तः leaving, राघवं Rama, तदा then

40021594.author: Translation
40021594.content: At that time, all of them, full of tears and with tearful eyes, were bewildered and stupefied by sorrow as they were leaving Rama.

40021595.author: पदार्थः
40021595.content: कृतप्रसादाः having received grace, तेन by him, एवं thus, राघवेण by Rama, महात्मना by the great-souled, जग्मुः they went, स्वं स्वं their own respective, गृहं home, सर्वे all, देही an embodied soul, देहं the body, इव as if, त्यजन् abandoning

40021595.author: Translation
40021595.content: Having thus received grace from the great-souled Rama, all of them returned to their respective homes, feeling as if an embodied soul abandoning its body.

40021596.author: पदार्थः
40021596.content: ततः then, तु indeed, ते those, राक्षसऋक्षवानराः Rakshasas, bears, and monkeys, प्रणम्य having bowed down, रामं to Rama, रघुवंशवर्धनम् the enhancer of the Raghu dynasty, वियोगजाश्रुप्रतिपूर्णलोचनाः with eyes full of tears born of separation, प्रतिप्रयाताः returned, तु indeed, यथा to their respective, निवासिनः abodes

40021596.author: Translation
40021596.content: Then, those Rakshasas, bears, and monkeys, having bowed down to Rama, the enhancer of the Raghu dynasty, returned to their respective abodes with eyes full of tears born of separation. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे चत्वारिंशः सर्गः ।। 40 ।। Thus ends the fortieth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
